summary.name: Talk Python To Me
summary.one_liner: Talk Python To Me is a weekly long-form podcast for Python developers, data scientists, and AI builders, featuring one-hour interviews with people building Python tools.
use_cases: Listening to Python developer interviews on commute
Finding Python podcast episodes by topic or guest
Learning about AI agents and Python tooling
Querying episode data from an AI assistant via MCP
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes the Talk Python To Me weekly podcast, with recent episodes on topics such as the self-hosted Hermes AI agent, Cloudflare Python Workers, connecting agents to data via MCP versus CLI, and designing large Django applications. Each episode is a casual one-hour conversation with guests. The site offers a searchable index of 566+ episodes with transcripts, guests, and courses. It exposes this data through an MCP server at talkpython.fm/api/mcp with 12 tools, and through a Talk Python CLI installable with uv. Related offerings include online Python courses, team training plans, a book on taking Python projects to production, and a sister show called Python Bytes.
notable: Searchable archive of 566+ episodes with full transcripts
Official MCP server with 12 tools for episode and course data
Talk Python CLI with text, JSON, or Markdown output
Sister show Python Bytes delivers weekly Python headlines in 15-20 minutes
caveats: Online courses, team training, and the book are paid offerings; exact prices are not stated on the page
Podcast is listed on Python podcast apps and iTunes, but the page does not name a specific podcast platform beyond iTunes review prompts
